ruleDefinitions.name: Wmiexec Default Output File
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of the default output filename used by the wmiexec tool

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX("\Windows\__1\d{9}.\d{1,7}$") OR file_path = RGX("C:\__1\d{9}.\d{1,7}$") OR file_path = RGX("D:\__1\d{9}.\d{1,7}$"))
